mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate above the 3-month moving average indicates accelerating economic activity, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth rate fails to correlate positively with 20-day SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.5% signals severe labor market distress, leading to immediate negative equity returns as investors anticipate economic contraction and policy delays.
evidence_refs: fact:Unemployment rate at 9.8% as of t-1mo
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 9.5%, 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS and high UNRATE (above 9.5%) indicates aggressive monetary easing to combat unemployment, generating positive equity returns as the economy stabilizes within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (FEDFUNDS change * UNRATE) fails to yield a positive Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing activity and strong corporate demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, INDPRO growth fails to predict positive 60-day SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: Rising CPIAUCSL (inflation) pressures the Fed to tighten monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL growth rate fails to correlate negatively with 20-day SPX returns (Rank IC > -0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 520,000 units signal strong consumer confidence and economic momentum, driving immediate positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Housing starts at 519.0 as of t-2mo
failure_condition: When HOUST > 520, 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: Rising consumer credit (RSAFS) combined with near-zero FEDFUNDS rates indicates strong consumer spending and accommodative monetary policy, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (RSAFS growth * FEDFUNDS) fails to yield a positive Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recoveries, sustained growth in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals improving labor market conditions and rising corporate hiring, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: In post-recession recoveries, PAYEMS growth fails to predict positive 60-day SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.03).
